name: cap_depth_mixed
about: The record size cap (512 KiB) and the depth bound (64 levels) on real nodes, then one oracle on the previous release. The worker r1w-01 writes through its own CStore API a value just under the cap, one just over it, one nested 64 levels and one nested 65; what every oracle and the worker hold is read. Then r1s-02 moves to tree 'old' (one step of a rolling update) and writes, through its own CStore API, a value over the cap and a plain key under the tombstone prefix 'dl:' (which a node of the previous release accepts and sends, and the new nodes must drop); the new nodes' counters are read over the next 10 minutes, to see whether anything sends the record again. Needs a cluster where every node runs tree 'next', r1w-01 runs CSTORE_MANAGER_API (--full-workers 1 --web-of r1w-01=CSTORE_MANAGER_API) and r1s-02 runs it beside dAuth.
